content:
Iris (Finance): Need quick guidance for month-end: customer Nebula paid a quarterly Dedicated prepay but downgraded capacity mid-cycle and Billing issued a partial credit (INV-2026-0901, CM-10234). How should we show the deferral and recognition on 03/31?

Ethan (Billing): Billing issued CM-10234 on 2026-03-14. Original prepaid covered 03/01-05/31 (92 days). They used 13 days at original level, then reduced. We netted the credit against the prepaid invoice.

Marta (Revenue Ops): Treat the credit as an adjustment to the deferred balance as of the CM date. Earned through 03/31 = pro-rated days used on the net prepaid amount. We'll flag INV-2026-0901 as "midterm-credit" in scheduler so it emits a truncated revenue schedule.

Omar (Accounting): GL mapping: Cash/AR (1010), Deferred Rev (2205), Revenue-Dedicated (4002), Credits (2108). Procedure: 1) Reduce deferred balance by CM-10234; 2) Recognize earned portion through 03/31 from the adjusted deferred balance. Example JE (simplified):
Dr Unearned Revenue (2205) $4,200  (adjust for CM)
Cr Cash/AR (1010)       $4,200  (credit memo/refund applied)
Then at month-end to recognize earned portion:
Dr Unearned Revenue (2205) $3,150
Cr Revenue - Dedicated (4002) $3,150
(Amounts illustrativerun numbers from CSV.)

Iris (Finance): Can Billing post the CSV with inv id, orig_amt, cm_amt, cm_ref, start_date, cm_date, days_used_by_3_31 so I can calculate exact JEs? Also need a one-line memo for the close pack stating rationale.

Ethan (Billing): Uploading CSV now to #finance-uploads: 1773050000-nebula-midterm.csv. Fields: inv_id, start_date, end_date, orig_amount, cm_amount, cm_ref, cm_date, days_used_through_3_31.

CloseBot: Reminder: attach manual adjustment memo to 03/31 close pack.

Marta (Revenue Ops): We'll push the scheduler flag so next month the adjustment is picked up automatically. Also propose we document policy in pricing-experiments: credits issued before period-end reduce deferred; credits after recognition may require contra adjustments.

Omar (Accounting): Good. Irisonce CSV is in I'll prepare the JE lines and post them here for quick review before we lock the close.

Iris (Finance): Thanks all will watch for the JE draft. :white_check_mark:
